basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Engineer | Agentic Systems, RAG & Evaluation Harnesses | Client-Facing Delivery
basics.summary: Hands-on AI engineer who ships production agentic systems end-to-end. At LumApps, built multi-agent outbound systems with structured outputs and AI Brain, a knowledge-graph RAG layer (Neo4j, Graphiti, Zep) with Langfuse-backed evaluation. Six years technical lead at Beekeeper across CrewAI, Strands Agents, LangChain, OpenAI. Three companies founded on the side; consulting-fluent from Tenity advisory and Obermatt PM. Cursor and Claude Code are my daily toolkit.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI agent platform end-to-end: architecture, multi-agent orchestration, RAG grounding, evaluation, and rollout.
highlights: Designed and shipped production agentic systems: LLM agents with structured outputs, deterministic orchestration, grounded in client knowledge bases. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day.

Built AI Brain, a knowledge-graph RAG layer (Neo4j, Graphiti, Zep) that grounds agents in conversation data, usage analytics, and notes. Unifies 8+ data silos so agents reason over typed relationships.
Stood up the evaluation harness: Langfuse for observability, replay-driven evals on a golden set, prompt regression gates before rollout. Quality decisions made on measured results, not vibes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Hands-on technical lead. Owned multiple production AI systems for 10M+ frontline workers with full evaluation, CI/CD, and observability discipline.
highlights: Built and operated multiple production LLM systems on real client traffic: AI Onboarding Specialist, GenAI demo generator, LLM translation pipeline. Real users, real failure modes, full evaluation and observability stack (Langfuse, CrewAI, Strands Agents).
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated; automated scoring and quality gates from day one.
Led Search Platform revamp across 3 teams. Redesigned indexing, ranking, and retrieval (the RAG foundation that downstream agents reason over).
Co-owned GTM launches with Sales and PM. Customer-facing technical delivery: clean handovers, measurable outcomes, killed what did not move the metric within a week.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Client-facing advisory for seed-to-VC stage founders. Evaluates AI architecture and advises on production AI delivery.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on AI architecture, RAG/agent design, and production readiness. Direct stakeholder communication with founders and investment committees.
Advised portfolio companies on agentic workflows, evaluation pipelines, and clean technical handovers.

work.name: Obermatt
work.summary: Bridged business and engineering for a Zurich fintech. Direct stakeholder ownership: roadmap, delivery, communication.
highlights: Translated business priorities into engineering execution. Direct work with non-technical stakeholders; clean delivery handovers.
Led a remote engineering team. Introduced agile + CI/CD with Docker; productivity up 20%, deployment times down 30%.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer at an EPFL spin-off. Built end-to-end platform and the cloud-native infrastructure that enabled enterprise partnerships.
highlights: Architected end-to-end platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS). 500+ autonomous deliveries; enterprise partnerships with Unilever and a CES Las Vegas showcase.
Built CI/CD pipeline and cloud infrastructure from scratch. Real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization: 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research at EPFL. Built Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms.
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source AI platform at one of Europe's top labs. Foundational work on optimization, search, and learning that informs how I architect agent reasoning loops today.
Migrated simulation pipeline to AWS; secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics. Supervised 20+ master's students; early reps at translating technical depth into non-expert stakeholder understanding.

highlights: Real-time multi-agent system that generates signals AND justifies them. Live users, real money, evaluation loop on every signal.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: AI Engineer at Voila AI (Zurich, remote contract). Deploy production AI systems for knowledge-intensive teams (investment, consulting, tech, industrials). Hands-on: design and build agentic systems (LLM agents with structured outputs, RAG over client knowledge bases, deterministic orchestration), engineer the supporting stack (APIs, data models, integrations, audit/access), stand up evaluation harnesses (test sets, automated scoring, model comparison), work with client teams and hand over cleanly. Strong Python (or .NET), Azure (AI Foundry, OpenAI, Containers), RAG/LLM application experience, evaluation discipline, Cursor/Claude Code fluency. Consulting experience appreciated. Auth to work in Switzerland required.
_jobApplication.notes: Strong match on agentic + RAG + evaluation harness + client-facing delivery. Gaps: no direct Azure (uses GCP/AWS), no .NET (Python only), no Swiss university degree (EPFL is research/teaching, not enrolled student). Consulting/client-facing covered via Tenity + Obermatt + founder roles.
